title: 🤖 Editor crashes when hiding an EditorNode3DGizmo without a plugin
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: Godot v4.8.dev3.official [51105ccbe].
- Not reproducible in: Godot v4.8.dev2.official [7220d456d].
- Not reproducible in: a custom build from master [b13043816a] with the proposed fix applied.

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev6 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors (2560x1600 @ 240.00 Hz, 2400x1350 @ 60.00 Hz) - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1664) - Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 9 275HX (8 threads) - 63.43 ГіБ memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

The editor crashes when `EditorNode3DGizmo.set_hidden(true)` is called on a gizmo that was added directly to a `Node3D` and therefore has no associated `EditorNode3DGizmoPlugin`.

I initially encountered this while using Terrain3D. The editor crashes after selecting **Terrain3D > Set Up Navigation...**. The same crash occurs when manually adding a `NavigationRegion3D` and reparenting the Terrain3D node under it.

The attached minimal reproduction project reproduces the crash without Terrain3D or any other third-party plugin.

The crash occurs in `EditorNode3DGizmo::_update_bvh()`, which calls `gizmo_plugin->is_selectable_when_hidden()` without checking whether `gizmo_plugin` is null. Gizmos added directly through `Node3D.add_gizmo()` may legitimately have no plugin.

Expected behavior: hiding such a gizmo should not crash the editor. A hidden gizmo without a plugin should be treated as non-selectable.

> [!INFO]
> *AI disclosure*: This report was prepared with assistance from an autonomous AI agent on behalf of the user. I discovered and reproduced the Terrain3D crash and validated the patched engine build. The agent assisted with root-cause analysis, creation of the minimal reproduction project, and preparation of the proposed C++ fix.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Download and extract the attached minimal reproduction project.
2. Open the project in Godot 4.8 dev3 or another affected build.
3. Open `node_3d.tscn` if it is not opened automatically.
4. Wait for the scene to finish loading.
5. The tool script creates an `EditorNode3DGizmo` without an `EditorNode3DGizmoPlugin`, adds it directly to the `Node3D`, and calls `set_hidden(true)`.
6. The editor crashes in `EditorNode3DGizmo::_update_bvh()`.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

The attached GDScript project reproduces the crash without Terrain3D or any other third-party plugin.

[gizmo-null-plugin-repro.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32742292/gizmo-null-plugin-repro.zip)
